proof_body:
by
  intro G X _ _ _ N hN x y
  obtain ⟨g, rfl⟩ := MulAction.exists_smul_eq G x y
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fun z : X => g • z) := MulAction.injective g
  have himg : (fun z : X => g • z) '' MulAction.orbit N x = MulAction.orbit N (g • x) := by
    ext z
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨_, ⟨n, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨g * n * g⁻¹, hN.conj_mem _ n.2 g⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [Subgroup.smul_def, mul_smul]
    · rintro ⟨n, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨_, ⟨⟨g⁻¹ * n * g, ?_⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
      · simpa using hN.conj_mem _ n.2 g⁻¹
      · simp [Subgroup.smul_def, mul_smul]
  exact ⟨(Equiv.Set.image _ _ hinj).trans (Equiv.setCongr himg)⟩
target_source: ∀ (G X : Type*) [Group G] [MulAction G X] [MulAction.IsPretransitive G X] (N : Subgroup G), N.Normal → ∀ x y : X, Nonempty (MulAction.orbit N x ≃ MulAction.orbit N y)
